Needs changes before merge.

The local checks passed. Two items are missing from the PR body.

The clipping keeps the corner cuts and removes the inner return legs. The shared emitter retains the entry, arc, fillet, and crossing checks. Parameter validation, undo, project storage, and MCP tests passed.

- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed, with zero warnings.

Safety checks

I read all 86 lines of `crates/app/tests/golden/pocket_rest_corners.cl`. I also compared each changed line with the parent golden. The move count changes from 126 to 84. The cuts retain all four corners at Z 20000, 18000, and 16000. The first entry moves to `(27700, 16451)`. The inner return arcs are removed. The golden and stock-simulation tests passed.

I ran two of the reported mutations against `rest_rings_do_not_feed_over_cleared_floor`:

| Mutation | Result with mutation | Result after restoration |
|---|---|---|
| Disable `anchor_first_pass` | Failed: `0.79 mm cleared-floor feed` | Passed |
| Change the clipping margin from `r + REST_REACH * 0.5` to `r + REST_REACH` | Failed: `53.45 mm cleared-floor feed` | Passed |

I restored each file byte for byte. The worktree has no uncommitted changes.

Requested before merge

1. `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:142`: this PR includes a process-file change relative to current upstream main. Add the exact line `Process change: yes` to this PR body. The line in the parent PR body does not cover this PR. Do not change `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_page.rs:243`: the PR includes a Pocket page change, but its body has no before/after screenshots. Add the required images to this PR body. The binding preserves the rest field and adds no visible control; the images can show that the page stays the same. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Do not commit them to the code branch.

Notes

The gate dry run selects most motion and app suites. I ran the suites in the table, not the complete quick gate. I did not run ignored tests or pixel snapshots. The body identifies rest geometries and entry combinations that were not exercised. PR #1817 must merge first, as stated in this PR body.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

- Added the exact line `Process change: yes` to this PR body.
- Added before/after Pocket Passes screenshots to this PR body. The actual renders are byte identical. Both links return HTTP 200. Images are stored only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch at `4d6408a5eb318eafa833785f0262d2d3b1d155ed`.
- Body pins pass. Removing the process line or either image makes its pin RED. Restoring each makes it GREEN.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all three steps. Clippy passed for motion, app, and UI with `--all-targets -- -D warnings`.

These fixes change only the PR body. Code head remains `0b0872d18a1f75dce96dbe428f059c7764f4db82`.

Please re-review.

Ready for the maintainer to merge, after parent PR #1817.

This is a second review of the same code head. The later `Addressed` comment requests this review of new evidence.

Both requests from my earlier review are now met. I withdraw those requests.

- The PR body has the exact line `Process change: yes`. The PR does not change `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.
- The body has before and after Pocket Passes screenshots. I downloaded and inspected the image. Both files have the same SHA-256 hash, as stated in the body.
- The image links name commit `4d6408a5eb318eafa833785f0262d2d3b1d155ed` on the fork's images branch. The code diff contains no PNG files.

I checked the rules in current `upstream/main:AGENTS.md`. I trial-merged this head with upstream main at `f90e9dc8ecd32a17d5a0379ff7d52f040a3c9d69`. The merge was clean. All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2154`. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Test build: motion, app, UI; `--no-run` | Passed |
| Motion `rest2d` | 13 passed |
| App `rest_pocket` | 6 passed |
| UI `lib`, from `crates/ui` | 914 passed; 6 ignored |
| Clippy: motion, app, UI; `--all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed; zero warnings |

The app tests check the golden, simulated stock, refusals, undo, project storage, and MCP parameters.

This is a safety-tier change. I compared each changed golden line with the parent version. The move count changes from 126 to 84. All four corner cuts remain at Z 20000, 18000, and 16000. The first entry moves to `(27700, 16451)`. The inner return arcs are removed.

I repeated two reported mutations against `rest_rings_do_not_feed_over_cleared_floor`:

| Mutation | With mutation | After restoration |
|---|---|---|
| Disable `anchor_first_pass` | RED: `0.79 mm cleared-floor feed` | GREEN |
| Use `r + REST_REACH` for the clipping margin | RED: `53.45 mm cleared-floor feed` | GREEN |

I restored both source files byte for byte. The working files match the trial-merge index.

Requested before merge: none.

The gate dry run completed. Its base-history comparison selects a batch fallback. I ran the checks above, not the full gate. The earlier review covers the other suites on this unchanged code head. Ignored tests and pixel snapshots were not run.

The stated stack still applies: merge #1817 first. The untested entry and geometry combinations remain listed in the body.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
